verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י בַּיּ֣וֹם מֹשֶׁ֔ה קָרָ֣א לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו וּלְזִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî haš·šə·mî·nî bay·yō·wm mō·šeh qā·rā lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw ū·lə·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: - On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַח־ לְ֠ךָ עֵ֣גֶל בֶּן־ בָּקָ֧ר לְחַטָּ֛את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וְהַקְרֵ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ- lə·ḵā ‘ê·ḡel ben- bā·qār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’a·yil lə·‘ō·lāh tə·mî·mim wə·haq·rêḇ lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: He said to Aaron Take for yourself a young bull . . . . . . for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering both without blemish and present them before the LORD

verses.original: תְּדַבֵּ֣ר וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר קְח֤וּ שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּים֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְעֵ֨גֶל וָכֶ֧בֶשׂ בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה תְּמִימִ֖ם לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḏab·bêr wə·’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr qə·ḥū śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·‘ê·ḡel wā·ḵe·ḇeś bə·nê- šā·nāh tə·mî·mim lə·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: Then speak to the Israelites . . . [and] say Take a male goat . . . for a sin offering a calf and a lamb both a year old . . . [and] without blemish for a burnt offering

verses.original: וְשׁ֨וֹר וָאַ֜יִל לִשְׁלָמִ֗ים לִזְבֹּ֙חַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָ֖ה בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן כִּ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם יְהוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·wr wā·’a·yil liš·lā·mîm liz·bō·aḥ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·min·ḥāh bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·šā·men kî hay·yō·wm Yah·weh nir·’āh ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: an ox and a ram for a peace offering to sacrifice before the LORD and a grain offering mixed with oil For today the LORD will appear to you

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֗וּ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה צִוָּ֣ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’êṯ ’ă·šer mō·šeh ṣiw·wāh ’el- pə·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yiq·rə·ḇū way·ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So they took - what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting and the whole congregation drew near and stood before the LORD

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר זֶ֧ה הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה צִוָּ֥ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃ וְיֵרָ֥א אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ta·‘ă·śū kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh wə·yê·rā ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: And Moses said This . . . is what the LORD has commanded you to do so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְרַ֤ב אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת־ חַטָּֽאתְךָ֙ וְאֶת־ עֹ֣לָתֶ֔ךָ וְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּֽעַדְךָ֖ וּבְעַ֣ד הָעָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת־ הָעָם֙ קָרְבַּ֤ן וְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּֽעֲדָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ צִוָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qə·raḇ ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wa·‘ă·śêh ’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḵap·pêr ba·‘aḏ·ḵā ū·ḇə·‘aḏ hā·‘ām wa·‘ă·śêh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām qā·rə·ban wə·ḵap·pêr ba·‘ă·ḏām ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: Then Moses said to Aaron Approach . . . the altar and sacrifice - your sin offering - and your burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and for the people And sacrifice - the people’s offering to make atonement for them as the LORD has commanded

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ וַיִּקְרַ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּשְׁחַ֛ט אֶת־ עֵ֥גֶל הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn ’el- way·yiq·raḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ‘ê·ḡel ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer- lōw
verses.literal: So Aaron . . . approached the altar and slaughtered - the calf as a sin offering - for himself

verses.original: אֶת־ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֣ן וַ֠יַּקְרִבוּ הַדָּם֮ אֵלָיו֒ וַיִּטְבֹּ֤ל אֶצְבָּעוֹ֙ בַּדָּ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־ יָצַ֔ק הַדָּ֣ם אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn way·yaq·ri·ḇū had·dām ’ê·lāw way·yiṭ·bōl ’eṣ·bā·‘ōw bad·dām way·yit·tên ‘al- qar·nō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·’eṯ- yā·ṣaq had·dām ’el- yə·sō·wḏ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: - The sons of Aaron brought the blood to him and he dipped his finger in the blood and applied it to the horns of the altar And he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה הִקְטִ֖יר הַחֵ֨לֶב וְאֶת־ הַכְּלָיֹ֜ת וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֤רֶת מִן־ הַכָּבֵד֙ מִן־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·ḥāh hiq·ṭîr ha·ḥê·leḇ wə·’eṯ- hak·kə·lā·yōṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yō·ṯe·reṯ min- hak·kā·ḇêḏ min- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh
verses.literal: - On the altar he burned the fat - the kidneys and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering as the LORD - had commanded Moses

verses.original: וְאֶת־ שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ הַבָּשָׂ֖ר וְאֶת־ הָע֑וֹר מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- śā·rap̄ bā·’êš hab·bā·śār wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ō·wr mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: But he burned up . . . the flesh - and the hide outside the camp

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֑ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֵלָיו֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֨י וַ֠יַּמְצִאוּ הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרְקֵ֥הוּ עַל־ סָבִֽיב׃ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh ’a·hă·rōn ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- bə·nê way·yam·ṣi·’ū had·dām way·yiz·rə·qê·hū ‘al- sā·ḇîḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then [Aaron] slaughtered - the burnt offering [His] . . . - sons brought him the blood and he splattered it on all sides of the altar

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הִמְצִ֧יאוּ אֵלָ֛יו הָעֹלָ֗ה לִנְתָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־ הָרֹ֑אשׁ וַיַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- him·ṣî·’ū ’ê·lāw hā·‘ō·lāh lin·ṯā·ḥe·hā wə·’eṯ- hā·rōš way·yaq·ṭêr ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: - They brought him the burnt offering piece by piece including the head and he burned them on the altar

verses.original: וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֶת־ הַקֶּ֖רֶב וְאֶת־ הַכְּרָעָ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עַל־ הָעֹלָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- haq·qe·reḇ wə·’eṯ- hak·kə·rā·‘ā·yim way·yaq·ṭêr ‘al- hā·‘ō·lāh ham·miz·bê·ḥāh
verses.literal: He washed - the entrails - and the legs and burned [them] atop the burnt offering on the altar

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת הָעָ֑ם קָרְבַּ֣ן וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ שְׂעִ֤יר לָעָ֔ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֥הוּ וַֽיְחַטְּאֵ֖הוּ כָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ ’êṯ hā·‘ām qā·rə·ban way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- śə·‘îr lā·‘ām ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer way·yiš·ḥā·ṭê·hū way·ḥaṭ·ṭə·’ê·hū kā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: Aaron then presented - the people’s offering He took - the male goat for the people’s sin offering - slaughtered it and offered it for sin like the first one

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֖ב אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲשֶׂ֖הָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh way·ya·‘ă·śe·hā kam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: He presented - the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֮ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָה֒ וַיְמַלֵּ֤א כַפּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וַיַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ מִלְּבַ֖ד הַבֹּֽקֶר׃ עֹלַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh way·mal·lê ḵap·pōw mim·men·nāh way·yaq·ṭêr ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ mil·lə·ḇaḏ hab·bō·qer ‘ō·laṯ
verses.literal: Next he presented - the grain offering took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחַ֤ט אֶת־ הַשּׁוֹר֙ וְאֶת־ הָאַ֔יִל לָעָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֶת־ בְּנֵ֨י וַ֠יַּמְצִאוּ הַדָּם֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיִּזְרְקֵ֥הוּ עַל־ סָבִֽיב׃ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- haš·šō·wr wə·’eṯ- hā·’a·yil lā·‘ām ’ă·šer ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- bə·nê way·yam·ṣi·’ū had·dām ’ê·lāw way·yiz·rə·qê·hū ‘al- sā·ḇîḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then he slaughtered - the ox - and the ram as the people’s - vvv peace offering [His] - sons brought him the blood . . . and he splattered it on all sides of the altar

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַחֲלָבִ֖ים מִן־ הַשּׁ֑וֹר וּמִן־ הָאַ֔יִל הָֽאַלְיָ֤ה וְהַֽמְכַסֶּה֙ וְהַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְיֹתֶ֖רֶת הַכָּבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·lā·ḇîm min- haš·šō·wr ū·min- hā·’a·yil hā·’al·yāh wə·ham·ḵas·seh wə·hak·kə·lā·yōṯ wə·yō·ṯe·reṯ hak·kā·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: - They also brought the fat portions from the ox . . . and the ram the fat tail [the fat] covering the entrails, the kidneys and the lobe of the liver

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת־ הַחֲלָבִ֖ים עַל־ הֶחָז֑וֹת וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַחֲלָבִ֖ים הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·lā·ḇîm ‘al- he·ḥā·zō·wṯ way·yaq·ṭêr ha·ḥă·lā·ḇîm ham·miz·bê·ḥāh
verses.literal: and placed - these on the breasts Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת אַהֲרֹ֛ן הֵנִ֧יף הֶחָז֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ הַיָּמִ֔ין שׁ֣וֹק תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃ צִוָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ’a·hă·rōn hê·nîp̄ he·ḥā·zō·wṯ wə·’êṯ hay·yā·mîn šō·wq tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer mō·šeh ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: but [he] waved the breasts - and the right thigh as a wave offering before the LORD as Moses had commanded

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ וַיִּשָּׂ֨א יָדוֹ אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֑ם מֵעֲשֹׂ֧ת הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְהָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃ וַיֵּ֗רֶד
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- way·yiś·śā yå̄·ḏō ’el- hā·‘ām way·ḇā·rə·ḵêm mê·‘ă·śōṯ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·‘ō·lāh wə·haš·šə·lā·mîm way·yê·reḏ
verses.literal: Aaron - lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them And having made the sin offering the burnt offering and the peace offering he stepped down

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וַיָּבֹ֨א אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֵּרָ֥א אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·yê·ṣə·’ū way·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh way·yê·rā ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Moses and Aaron then entered . . . the Tent of Meeting When they came out they blessed - the people and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people

verses.original: אֵשׁ֙ וַתֵּ֤צֵא מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַחֲלָבִ֑ים עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָם֙ וַיַּ֤רְא וַיָּרֹ֔נּוּ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êš wat·tê·ṣê mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh wat·tō·ḵal hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·lā·ḇîm ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām way·yar way·yā·rōn·nū way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed the burnt offering - and the fat portions on the altar - And when all the people saw it they shouted for joy and fell facedown . . .
